Decal_GlowPool.channels: R pool (1-r)^2.2 as GlowDecal.Radial, G wider soft falloff, B thin ring at r 0.74 (pulse), A = R

Glow_Blade.channels: U core (0) to rim (1), V base (0) to tip (1) as GlowDecal.Blade; R glow, G hot core line, B streaks (scroll V)

Field_Energy.channels: tiles in V (scroll it); U across the sheet. R scanlines (6 per tile, as GlowDecal.Scanlines), G hex lattice, B shimmer noise; every channel already faded at the U edges; A edge fade

Quad_Flat.note: flat on the ground (Unity XZ, normal +Y); scale = diameter

Quad_Upright.note: upright, faces Unity -Z (camera side); for the gate field sheet
